text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way back from an outing with Hishi Akebono—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, it's Nature-chan.
What are you doing over there?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nice timing, Akebono!
...And Trainer-san, too.
Could I borrow your ears for a moment?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature handed me a flyer.
Above photos of teacups, plates, and earthenware pots,
it read: "Craft Something Special, Just for You."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Free trial session... pottery class?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, apparently this place is run by someone the shopping district old-timer knows.
He told me to at least drop by and check it out, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
My schedule's a biiit packed right now,
so I don't think I can make it.
...Aand that's how it is~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
How about it, you two?
Right now, you can create your very own special item for free!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm in, I'm in! I'm definitely going!
Right, Trainer? ☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Accompanying Hishi Akebono after her instant reply,
we decided to go to a pottery class.
On the day of the lesson—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'm so excited, Trainer! Something made just for me... Ehehe, once it's finished, I'm gonna send a picture to my dad and the others!
choice_data_list: What Is Akebono Going to Make?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"For me, it's gotta be an earthenware pot!
I'm gonna make a clay pot so huge
one person can't even carry it on their own!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Eeeh?! You can't make an earthenware pot?!

text_block_list.name: Potter
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not that you can't do it.
It's just that it is quite difficult
for beginners, after all...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hrmmm. Since it goes directly over the fire,
it certainly must be quite a handful...

text_block_list.name: Potter
text_block_list.text:
"I see. That's why, at first,
we should start with something a bit easier to make—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Understood, I'll do my best!!
Clay pot!!

text_block_list.name: Potter
text_block_list.text: Huh, it really is an earthenware pot!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yes! Please do! Ah, of course, it's pretty big, so you really don't have to do it for free!

text_block_list.name: Potter
text_block_list.text: No, that's fine, but... mmm.
choice_data_list: How about improving your skills before taking on the challenge?

text_block_list.name: Potter
text_block_list.text:
Experience... yes, indeed.
Having someone as motivated as you join us
is a true pleasure on our end as well.

text_block_list.name: Potter
text_block_list.text: Understood, let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Waaa! Thank you so much!
Trainer, thank you to you too!

text_block_list.name: Potter
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's start with the design.
Please try putting the image in your mind down on paper.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Understood!
Ehehe, let's do this☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It's big... with a smooth shape. It's packed with ingredients, and you hold it like... this... and then like this...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The design Hishi Akebono came up with was so elaborate
that even a professional would struggle to bring it to life.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Making countless revisions along the way,
Hishi Akebono penned down her ideals with a serious look.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Phew. It's done, it's done!
This is mine, my very own special one!
How is it, Sensei?!

text_block_list.name: Potter
text_block_list.text:
Are you really sure about this...?
I mean, it's a wonderful design, but
it looks quite difficult to pull off...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'll give it my all!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps overwhelmed by Hishi Akebono's sheer enthusiasm,
the pottery instructor nodded almost reflexively.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the end, they only managed to finish the design that day, but Hishi Akebono was smiling happily the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mmh! But still,
I want my first one to be in an earthenware pot!
Yeah, an earthenware pot is the best.

text_block_list.name: Potter
text_block_list.text: Why are you so obsessed with clay pots?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I love cooking!
That's why I want to be picky about tableware too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: A pot might not be a serving plate, but just like one, it makes the food delicious and presents it beautifully, so it's super, super important!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That's why I really want to create
something special that's all my own!!

text_block_list.name: Potter
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, very true.
Understood. Let's make something amazing.
And for that, we start with the design!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yes, Sensei! I'll do my best!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To create the ideal clay pot, Hishi Akebono
earnestly threw herself into the design.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the end, they only managed to finish the design that day, but Hishi Akebono puffed out her chest with pride, thoroughly satisfied with what she'd made.
